notes.title: Updates for Version 0.7 (August 2022)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Visual Experience: [u]My Vision[/u].
[*] Added Visual Experience: [u]Shapes in the Sky[/u].
[*] Zoom Light Year Scale mode.  Note this mode is intentionally [b]not[/b] saved to your preferences; instead "Simple Rotation" will be selected on next app restart.  Whereas selecting “Latitude/Time Rotation" or "Simple Rotation" will be saved to preferences and automatically restored during subsequent startup.  I felt that Light Year Zoom was a novelty experience to "play with" for a little while, and not really desired as a long-term star viewing environment.
[*] Meteor Shower mode, which is "on" by default.
[*] Updated Intro text and added zooming super nova logo to match the marketing images found on the Steam store/library.
[*] Fixed a bug where any "Image Zoomer" screens created during a Visual Experience were "leftover" (not cleaned up) if the experience was terminated early (press and hold "A" button) while image was being displayed.
[*] Replaced ugly "galaxy disk" in the Visual Experience "The Night Sky in 3D" with a high-res Milky Way skybox.  I plan to eventually go back to a "good looking" galaxy disk in the future, but I feel the skybox is better for now.
[*] A few additional minor fixes
[/list]
